text:
Nina: Heads-up: I'm putting together a short 'manager first-week kit' we can attach to offers. Goal: remove admin guesswork and give new managers a predictable 7-day ramp. quick thoughts?
Diego: Love it. Must-have: a compact who-to-contact list (IT, Security, Facilities, Legal) so managers don't hunt.
Riley: Also include a forkable 30/60/90 template that's outcome-focused. Make it copy-paste friendly.
Ben: Security must-dos: enable MFA, verify disk encryption, KMS access request flow, incident runbook access. Mark items Must / Soon / Optional.
Nina: Draft outline below. Target < 4 hours of scheduled meetings across week 1.
Nina: Pre-start (22 days before): submit Okta + infra access tickets, confirm laptop shipment, assign onboarding buddy, badge request if office.
BadgeBot: Badge request queued. ETA 2 business days.
Riley: Day 1 (half-day): 30m PeopleOps welcome, 20m HR admin (pay/benefits/NDAs), 30m team meet & greet, 15m systems access walkthrough (Okta, Console links).
Diego: Day 2: 45m Product context & roadmap, 30m Security intro (Ben covers), 30m Buddy shadow.
Ben: Add a 15m "how to escalate a security incident" runbook walkthrough (link to runbook).
Nina: Day 3: 45m 30/60/90 planning workshop (manager-only), 30m 1:1 kickoff template with direct reports.
Riley: Day 4: Ops primer (monitoring, SLAs, Redwood Console tour) 60m. Day 5: Stakeholder intros + week recap (30m).
Diego: Pasteable calendar bundle for offers:
"- Day 1 09:30 - PeopleOps: Welcome & Admin (50m)
- Day 1 11:00 - Team meet & greet (30m)
- Day 2 10:00 - Product + Roadmap (45m)
- Day 2 14:00 - Security intro (30m)
- Day 3 10:00 - 30/60/90 planning (45m)
- Day 4 09:30 - Infra & Monitoring primer (60m)
- Day 5 15:00 - Stakeholder intro + Week 1 recap (30m)"
Nina: 30/60/90 skeleton (copyable):
"- 30d: meet cross-functional partners, finalize team access, ship first small process improvement.
- 60d: own a prioritized backlog item, introduce a repeatable planning cadence, collect a feedback cycle.
- 90d: implement one operational improvement, set draft OKRs, present progress to stakeholders"
Riley: I'll add three example goals by team type (infra, product, platform) to help translation.
Ben: Flag compliance hires: "If handling regulated data, schedule Legal & Security intake in week 1."
Nina: Proposal: a 5-question end-of-week survey to capture friction (access, docs missing, unclear owners, meeting overload, onboarding pace). short checkboxes.
Diego: Could we auto-tag IT if the survey reports 'access problems'? Worth exploring.
Riley: Include a pasteable 1:1 agenda snippet: "Wins / Blockers / Priorities / Support needed" (15m).
Nina: Note for hiring managers: create Okta + infra tickets 3 working days before start. avoids laptop/VPN delays.
Diego: I'll make a Google Calendar template and a one-page PDF cheat sheet for offer packets.
Nina: Upload plan to People Ops docs and link here when ready. https://redwood.link/new-manager-kit (will post final link).
Riley: Thanks all. Ping me if anything obvious is missing. :raised_hands:
